experiments.name: operand dependency chain
experiments.notes: rd -> ARMFLAGS chain closed by armmfflag; 1 cycle subtracted.

latencies.notes: rd -> ARMFLAGS chain closed by armmfflag; 2 cycles subtracted. Raw slope-method measurement was 3.01; the nominal value is 3 cycle(s).

experiments.name: rk to flags chain
experiments.init: li.d $r12, 5; li.d $r13, 7; li.d $r14, 9; li.d $r15, 11; armmtflag $r12, 0xff; x86mtflag $r12, 0x3f
experiments.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 20000 --unroll2 40000 --iters 100 --warmup 10 --reps 10 --init 'li.d $r12, 5; li.d $r13, 7; li.d $r14, 9; li.d $r15, 11; armmtflag $r12, 0xff; x86mtflag $r12, 0x3f' --asm 'armsll.w $r12, $r13, 14; armmfflag $r13, 0xff'

latencies.notes: rk -> ARMFLAGS: the chain closes through `armmfflag` writing rk back from the flags, so the measured 4.00 cycles less the 2-cycle flag move leave 2, the same as the rj path.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: armsll.w $r12, $r4, 14; armsll.w $r13, $r5, 14; armsll.w $r14, $r6, 14; armsll.w $r15, $r7, 14; armsll.w $r16, $r8, 14; armsll.w $r17, $r9, 14; armsll.w $r18, $r10, 14; armsll.w $r19, $r11, 14
throughput.init: addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8; armmtflag $r0, 0x39
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 10 --init 'addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8; armmtflag $r0, 0x39' --asm 'armsll.w $r12, $r4, 14; armsll.w $r13, $r5, 14; armsll.w $r14, $r6, 14; armsll.w $r15, $r7, 14; armsll.w $r16, $r8, 14; armsll.w $r17, $r9, 14; armsll.w $r18, $r10, 14; armsll.w $r19, $r11, 14'
throughput.notes: 8 independent lanes take 16.00 cycles, i.e. 2 CPI. The instruction is a single uop; its conditional execution limits it to one per two cycles (armmfflag and armmove are not conditional on register data and run at one per cycle). Re-measured on 2026-11-17 on LA664, core 0, with --method slope (--unroll 250 --unroll2 1000) and confirmed with the 0x01 uop counter.

notes: LBT ARM-style instruction. Latency is recorded for each source operand: rj -> ARMFLAGS (3). Only ARMFLAGS is written: the general-purpose registers are read-only sources for this instruction (verified with a native test program, where armadd.w, armsub.w, armand.w, armmov.w, armrotr.w and armrrx.w leave every GPR unchanged while ARMFLAGS changes; the conditional move armMove is the exception and does write its destination).
